system.description:
Kannagi Exclusive. [Trigger: Text] Use this when you start your main process. You may [Instant Teleport] up to 2Sq. When your main process ends, you will return to the Sq where you were when you started your main process using [Instant Teleport]. Once per scenario. - Light armor embroidered with the pattern of the Misty Script, exclusive to Kannagi. It possesses a pseudo-teleportation ability, allowing for instantaneous movement over short distances, but the user will be returned to their original position after a certain period of time.

Mist Kasuri Cloth [Core Material] (80G) + Traveler's Tunic (270G) + [Magic Catalyst 6] (50G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (220G)
